page.h1: iPhone case with strap: which case fits which crossbody strap
page.desc: Bandolier's Palmer Magnet Duet includes a clear case, crossbody strap and wristlet for $98. Apple's strap fits only some Apple cases. Here's the list for each iPhone.
page.answer: Short answer. For an iPhone case with a strap in one box, get Bandolier's Palmer Magnet Duet: clear MagSafe case, crossbody chain and wristlet for $98. Apple's $59 Crossbody Strap fits only Apple's Silicone or TechWoven Case on iPhone 17 Pro; the Clear Case works only from iPhone 18 Pro.

page.after:
What the differences mean

  • Apple's own setup costs more and has no wristlet. On an iPhone 17 Pro, the Silicone Case plus the Crossbody Strap comes to $49 + $59 = $108 for a single crossbody strap. Adding Apple's $29 Wrist Strap brings it to $108 + $29 = $137.
  • Bandolier's Palmer Magnet Duet includes both straps for less. At $98 with a crossbody and a wristlet, it costs $108 − $98 = $10 less than Apple's crossbody-only setup, and $137 − $98 = $39 less than Apple's case with both straps.
  • The gift set adds a ring for $1. The Ring It On Set is the same Palmer Duet plus the Zoe ring holder and stand: $99 − $98 = $1 more. Bandolier calls it a holiday set, so the $99 price may not last.
  • The cheapest way to keep your own case. If your case already has strap loops, Peak Design's strap plus a Micro Anchor 3-pack costs $49.95 + $14.95 = $64.90.
  • How far each strap reaches. Apple's strap adjusts from 108 to 208 cm, a range of 208 − 108 = 100 cm (39.4 in). Bandolier's Miller strap runs 37.5–58.5 in, so Apple's longest setting is 81.9 − 58.5 = 23.4 in longer. Bandolier doesn't publish the length of the Palmer chain. Bandolier's 'strap length' means the whole strap, not the drop, which is where the phone hangs on your body.

Which Apple cases take Apple's Crossbody Strap

Apple's strap never clips onto the iPhone itself. Apple's support page says to start with the case off the phone and thread each connector's cord loop from the outside through one of the small openings in the case's bottom corners. The strap then snaps onto those connectors. A case without the two openings can't take the strap, and Apple says only "select Apple iPhone cases" are compatible. Apple also warns that the strap contains magnets that may interfere with medical devices.

iPhoneApple cases that take the strap
iPhone 18 Pro / 18 Pro MaxTechWoven, Silicone, Clear (all with MagSafe)
iPhone 17 Pro / 17 Pro MaxTechWoven, Silicone (Clear Case not listed)
iPhone 17Silicone
iPhone 17eSilicone
iPhone AiriPhone Air Bumper, iPhone Air Case with MagSafe

The Clear Case is where people get caught. When the iPhone 17 Pro launched, Apple paired the strap with the TechWoven and Silicone cases only. For the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple says the Clear Case "features an updated design and is now compatible" with the Crossbody Strap and Wrist Strap. iPhone 16 and older models aren't on Apple's list at all. Owners of those phones need a case that comes with its own straps, like Bandolier's, or a Peak Design strap on a case with strap loops. If your Apple case is on the list above, the strap alone is all you need: {buy:apple-crossbody-strap-black}

Not recommended

Apple's Crossbody Strap for an iPhone 17 Pro or 17 Pro Max in Apple's Clear Case. That Clear Case isn't on Apple's compatibility list. Either switch to Apple's Silicone or TechWoven case first, or skip Apple's strap and get a case that comes with straps.
